title: Brinepost
timingBasis: UTC clock readings from the start of the gameplay brief through the final syntax and interaction checks
mobileSupportNotes: A real browser at 390 × 844 CSS pixels passed start, placement, tower selection, upgrade and sell using pointer clicks, without horizontal overflow. Physical touch hardware was not tested.

validation.syntax: Passed node --check on the inline classic JavaScript; independently rechecked by the parent.
validation.browser: Passed parent smoke test in the Codex browser through the local project preview at desktop and phone width, without console errors.
validation.interaction: Passed a Node VM simulation with a 350 CSS-pixel-wide board. Simulated clicks exercised the start overlay, tower selection, placement, upgrade, sale, and restart. The first nine seconds of frame updates ran at 17 ms per frame and awarded points during wave one. Restart was tested from a simulated defeat.
validation.render: Canvas defense map confirmed visually in desktop and phone-width screenshots.
validation.parentInteractions: Start, build, select, upgrade and sell passed at 390 × 844 using pointer clicks. First-wave combat, scoring and scrap updates were observed.
validation.fixes: The generating subagent corrected a negative mortar drawing radius found during its Node VM frame simulation, then reran the simulation successfully.
